errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: This exam link has expired. Please contact the recruiter to ask for a new one.
errors.INVITE_REVOKED: This exam link is no longer valid. Please contact the recruiter.
errors.LINK_BOUND_TO_OTHER_SESSION: This link was already opened in another browser. Please use that browser, or ask the recruiter to reset your link.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This exam must be taken on a laptop or desktop computer with a wide enough window.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Please agree to the consent statement before you continue.
errors.CAMERA_REQUIRED: The camera is needed for this exam. Please allow camera access and take your photo.
errors.HELP_REQUEST_PENDING: Your help request is waiting for a decision. You can continue once it is answered.
errors.EXAM_NOT_STARTED: The exam has not started yet.
errors.EXAM_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: This exam has already been submitted.
errors.EXAM_TIME_OVER: The time for this exam is over.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find this exam link. Please check the address or contact the recruiter.
errors.ORG_DISABLED: This exam is not available right now. Please contact the recruiter.
errors.ROLE_NOT_OPEN: This exam is not open right now. Please contact the recruiter.
errors.ROLE_HAS_NO_ASSESSMENT: This exam is not ready yet. Please contact the recruiter.

thanks.title: Thank you, your exam has been submitted
thanks.body: Your answers were received. The hiring team will review them and be in touch.
thanks.close: You can close this window now.

device.title: Please use a laptop or desktop
device.body: This exam cannot be taken on a phone, a tablet or a small window. Open the link on a laptop or desktop computer.

resume.title: Your exam is still running
resume.body: The page was reloaded. Your saved answers are safe and the timer kept running. Continue to return to fullscreen and to your questions.

instructions.title: Before you begin
instructions.summary_one: You have {{minutes}} minutes to answer {{count}} question.
instructions.summary_other: You have {{minutes}} minutes to answer {{count}} questions.

rule.alone: Take the exam alone, in a quiet place.
rule.noHelp: Do not use notes, other people, other devices or other websites.
rule.noLeave: Stay on this page. Do not switch tabs or windows.
rule.fullscreen: The exam runs in fullscreen. If you leave fullscreen, you will be asked to return.
rule.timer: The timer runs on our server and cannot be paused, even if your connection drops.
rule.autosave: Your answers are saved automatically as you type.

monitor.screen: Your activity on this page while the exam runs.
monitor.tabs: Whether you leave this page or the fullscreen view.
monitor.camera: Your camera, with photos taken during the exam.
monitor.keys: Copy, paste, right-click and developer tool shortcuts are turned off.

instructions.cameraNotice: Your camera stays on and is monitored for the whole exam, even when you hide the camera preview. Hiding the preview only hides the picture on your screen.

consent.title: Consent
consent.noDocument: By continuing you agree that your answers and activity during this exam are recorded for the hiring team.
consent.cameraNotice: The camera stays on and is monitored during the whole exam, even if you hide the preview.
consent.agree: I have read the statement above and I agree.

check.title: System check
check.intro: A few quick checks before the timer starts. The timer only starts when you press Start the exam.

screen.title: Screen size
screen.small: Your window is narrower than {{width}} pixels. Make it wider or use a larger screen.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Allow camera access when your browser asks. Sit in good light and look at the camera.
camera.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings for this site, then try again.
camera.unavailable: No working camera was found. Connect one and try again, or ask for help below.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.body: Take a clear photo of your face. Only you should be in the picture.
photo.noFrame: The camera has not produced a picture yet. Wait a moment and try again.

face.none: No face is visible. Look at the camera.
face.many: More than one face is visible. Only you should be in the picture.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
fullscreen.body: The exam runs in fullscreen. Try it now; it will close again.
fullscreen.unsupported: Fullscreen is not available in this browser. You can continue.

check.helpPending: Your help request is waiting for a decision. You can start once it is answered.

help.waiting: Your help request was sent. Please wait here; the recruiter will answer it.
help.approved: Your request was approved. You can continue.
help.declined: Your request was not approved. You can still continue with the exam as it is.
help.title: Request help
help.description: Tell us what is wrong. The recruiter decides inside the platform.

reasons.no_camera: I do not have a camera

camera.lost: Your camera stopped working. Please reconnect it. The exam keeps running.

exam.offline: You are offline. Your answers are kept on this device and will be sent when the connection returns. The timer keeps running.

fullscreen.title: Return to fullscreen
fullscreen.body: The exam runs in fullscreen. Return to fullscreen to carry on. Your timer is still running.

lockdown.note: That action is turned off during the exam.

submit.confirmBody: You answered {{answered}} of {{total}} questions. After you submit you cannot change your answers.
submit.saveFailed: We could not save your latest answers yet. Check your connection and press Submit again.
submit.failed: We could not submit yet. Check your connection and press Submit again. Your answers are safe.
